first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A single human-shaped subject wearing a tight-fitting red-and-blue outfit above the street, inverted in the early and middle portions and curled up with bent legs in the final portion.

entities.name: Gray overcast sky
entities.identification: The gray sky above the cluster of buildings, with clearly varying light and dark cloud layers at the beginning of the clip and only a small light-gray area visible at the end.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: A collection of brown, reddish-brown, gray, and dark-colored buildings of varying heights on both sides of the road and in the distance.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: The gray road extending into the distance between the central buildings and the intersections along it.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green clumped tree canopies on both sides of the road and in open spaces between the buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: A group of light-colored, yellow, and dark-colored background cars on the road, not separated into independently tracked vehicles.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A collection of billboards attached to the exteriors of buildings, including a narrow purplish-red billboard surface at the beginning of the clip and yellow and blue-purple horizontal billboard surfaces at the end.
